title: Add bulk discount tiers
body: Orders of 50+ units get 5% off, 100+ get 10% off.
head: feat/discount-tiers

reviews.author: alice
reviews.body: One nit, plus a design question.

comments.author: alice
comments.body: Rather than hard-coding the tiers, should these come from the pricing config ops already edits (config/pricing.toml)? Then they could change tiers without a deploy. Not sure it's worth it for this PR though, what do you think?
